WITH filtered_item AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_manager_id
    FROM item
    WHERE ((i_category IN ('Books','Children','Electronics')
            AND i_class IN ('personal','portable','reference','self-help')
            AND i_brand IN ('scholaramalgamalg #14','scholaramalgamalg #7','exportiunivamalg #9','scholaramalgamalg #9'))
        OR (i_category IN ('Women','Music','Men')
            AND i_class IN ('accessories','classical','fragrances','pants')
            AND i_brand IN ('amalgimporto #1','edu packscholar #1','exportiimporto #1','importoamalg #1')))
),
month_lookup AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_moy
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq IN (1222,1222+1,1222+2,1222+3,1222+4,1222+5,1222+6,1222+7,1222+8,1222+9,1222+10,1222+11)
),
fact_month AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_item_sk, fi.i_manager_id, ml.d_moy,
           SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS item_month_sales
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN month_lookup ml ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = ml.d_date_sk
    JOIN filtered_item fi ON ss.ss_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
    WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM store s WHERE s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk)
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, fi.i_manager_id, ml.d_moy
),
manager_month AS (
    SELECT i_manager_id, d_moy, SUM(item_month_sales) AS sum_sales
    FROM fact_month
    GROUP BY i_manager_id, d_moy
),
manager_stats AS (
    SELECT i_manager_id, sum_sales,
           AVG(sum_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY i_manager_id) AS avg_monthly_sales
    FROM manager_month
)
SELECT i_manager_id, sum_sales, avg_monthly_sales
FROM manager_stats
WHERE CASE WHEN avg_monthly_sales > 0 THEN abs(sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales) / avg_monthly_sales ELSE NULL END > 0.1
ORDER BY i_manager_id, avg_monthly_sales, sum_sales
LIMIT 100
